text: opened #130 #15: one issuer per ticket - the issuer holds a per-ticket lock for its life and the controller honours it; #131 #15 #14: an issuer whose ticket is no longer its own stops without writing anything; #132 #14: a command that cannot start because its working directory is gone says so; #133 #14: the issuer makes a missing ticket worktree again from its branch before an agent command starts; #134 #16: an open group with a stuck member waits for its decision unless nothing needs it (D-097); #135 #16: the controller gives no new group to a ticket that left one; it waits for the main session (D-097 3); #136 #16: a stuck ticket's page says that its group and the groups after it wait for the decision
